title: Bound audit-log-exporter retry queue; add dropped-event metrics + backoff to reduce audit log gaps
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: audit-log-exporter: improved behavior under sink backpressure; adds `events_dropped_total` + clearer delivery semantics; safer defaults for queue and retry.
description:
Context
- Support escalations SUP-4812 (ACME Dedicated) and SUP-4879 (ZenBank Private) indicate audit-log-exporter v1.9.2 can wedge under backpressure (retries block dequeue) and/or drop events when queue fills.

What
- Introduce bounded queue with explicit policy: either block with timeout or drop-oldest with metric + log.
- Add exponential backoff with jitter on non-2xx responses.
- Add Prometheus metrics:
  - `exporter_send_attempts_total{status}`
  - `events_dropped_total{reason}`
  - `queue_depth`
- Improve logs to include sink status codes + batch ids.
- Update README: clarify delivery semantics (best-effort unless disk spool enabled; disk spool planned).

Testing
- Added unit tests for queue policy + backoff.
- Repro test with synthetic 429/503 in integration harness.

Rollout
- Patch release `v1.9.3` recommended for customers using Splunk HEC / webhook sinks.

Review conversation (abridged)
- Maya: can we make dropping impossible by default?
- Ethan: default is block+timeout with alerts; drop-oldest requires explicit opt-in env var.
- Ben: please ensure docs mention compliance implications; add runbook link.

Merge
- Squash merged to main; tag v1.9.3 planned after canary.
